roads.name: Road of the Sunderer
roads.line: Slow, huge blows that split the ground.

roads.name: Road of the Bulwark
roads.line: Walk in, let them hit you, and they break on it.

roads.name: Road of the Butcher
roads.line: Twin axes, and you fight best bleeding.

roads.name: Road of the Chainbound
roads.line: A hooked chain that drags the horde into knots, with lightning down it.

roads.name: Road of the Kindler
roads.line: Fire and frost on the ground: freeze them, then shatter them.

roads.name: Road of the Moonweaver
roads.line: Moonlight that hunts on its own and marks what it touches.

roads.name: Road of the Roadknife
roads.line: Twin blades: every dash goes through the crowd.

roads.name: Road of the Verge-Hunter
roads.line: A longbow: far off, pinning the front.

flares.name: The Long Cut
flares.text: A sweep of dawn 12 m round, then a cleave down a 24 m line.

flares.name: Dawn in the Steel
flares.text: For 6 s the blade burns with morning: faster swings, crescents of light, every heavy blow staggers.

flares.name: Bell of the Morning
flares.text: Three tolls on the shield: each stuns and sears everything near, and mends you 4%. The last is a holy blast 8 m round.

flares.name: Sixty on the Wall
flares.text: For 6 s the Watch's shield-bearers hold an arc in front of you.

flares.name: The Butcher's Bill
flares.text: A leap on the strongest near you, and a chop for each tenth of health you're missing (at least four): each mends 2%.

flares.name: Butcher's Hour
flares.text: For 8 s: Frenzy full, blows twice as fast, every blow deepens the bleed, ordinary things below 15% die, and each kill adds 0.3 s (up to 8 s more) and mends 1%.

flares.name: Drag Them Under
flares.text: Hooks bite everything within 14 m and haul it into one knot at your feet for the slam.

flares.name: Storm on the Chain
flares.text: For 5 s the chain sweeps 8 m out, and the sky strikes down it.

flares.name: Burns Twice
flares.text: Frost races under every pack near, then twelve embers fall on the frozen ground, and each shatters what is frozen round it.

flares.name: Hard Winter
flares.text: For 6 s the ford's cold: everything near slows and freezes, and the thaw bursts.

flares.name: The Branding
flares.text: Every enemy near is branded; the brands burst outward, each death passing a mark.

flares.name: The Drowned Moon
flares.text: For 6 s a pool of moonlight follows you and looses motes.

flares.name: The Road's Toll
flares.text: Gone in smoke: twelve cuts in 1.2 s on the strongest near, each poisoned, and anything below 25% dies. On a boss, the last four.

flares.name: Through and Through
flares.text: For 6 s your dashes are free and endless, and every one cuts.

flares.name: One Arrow
flares.text: One arrow down a 30 m line, splitting three times on the toughest.

flares.name: Pinning Rain
flares.text: For 5 s arrows rain on ground 12 m across, rooting what they strike.

lamps.name: The Warden's Oath
lamps.text: Your dash form is Bull Rush: every 8 s the next dash is a 6 m charge behind a barrier of 15% of health. What's in the way is thrown aside; a champion stops it, stunned.

lamps.name: Iron Hide
lamps.text: Bull Rush's barrier is 25% of health.

lamps.name: Pile Driver
lamps.text: The rush ends in a slam that stuns everything 3 m round.

lamps.name: Unbroken
lamps.text: Each thing the rush strikes adds 2% of health to the barrier.

lamps.name: Gore
lamps.text: What the rush strikes bleeds, and champions take half again.

lamps.name: Shield Bash
lamps.text: When three or more things, or a champion, are within 2.5 m: bash. They're thrown back and stunned 1.5 s, and a channel breaks. Every 7 s.

lamps.name: Concussion
lamps.text: Shield Bash stuns a second longer.

lamps.name: Shield Wall
lamps.text: Shield Bash gives a barrier of 8% of health for each thing struck, to 40%.

lamps.name: Braced
lamps.text: A blow that takes a seventh of your health or more plants you for 3 s: blows cut by 65%, arrows turned back. Every 20 s.

lamps.name: Rallying Stand
lamps.text: Mend 4% of health a second while braced.

lamps.name: Kindled Oath
lamps.text: Blows taken fill the Flare 20% faster.

lamps.name: Last at the Crossing
lamps.text: A Flare cast below a third of health also gives a barrier of 30% of health.

lamps.name: Hold Fast
lamps.text: You can't be thrown, stunned or slowed. Your dash is 30% shorter.

lamps.name: Banked Flame
lamps.text: Hold two Flares. The second fills half as fast; a Flare fired with both held strikes 75% harder.

lamps.name: Two Hands
lamps.text: Heavy blows stagger ordinary things for 0.4 s.
Heavy blows strike 12% harder at staggered things.
Heavy and nova skills reach 8% wider.
+2 Might.
Staggered things take 10% more holy.
+2 Might.
Each heavy blow landed in the last 3 s gives +1 armor, to +10.
Standing still, Sunder reaches 10% further.

lamps.name: Wide Swing
lamps.text: Sunder's arc is 300°.

lamps.name: Third Blow
lamps.text: Every third swing of Sunder is heavy.

lamps.name: Burning Edge
lamps.text: Sunder's heavy line sears.

lamps.name: Twin Cracks
lamps.text: Groundbreaker opens two cracks, splayed 30°.

lamps.name: Fault Line
lamps.text: Groundbreaker's cracks run 14 m.

lamps.name: Upheaval
lamps.text: Lesser things heaved are thrown up 0.8 s, and take 30% more while airborne.

lamps.name: Dawn Rhythm
lamps.text: Dawnpulse fires when you land a heavy blow instead of on its timer, at most every 1.5 s.

lamps.name: Wider Morning
lamps.text: Dawnpulse reaches 20% wider.

lamps.name: Searing Light
lamps.text: Dawnpulse sears what it strikes.

lamps.name: Breaking Point
lamps.text: Champions fill a stagger bar from heavy blows and break for 1.5 s.

lamps.name: Sundered
lamps.text: Heavy blows break armor: Sundered things take 20% more from heavy blows for 4 s.

lamps.name: Momentum of the Blade
lamps.text: A melee swing that kills three makes that skill's next swing come 25% sooner.

lamps.name: Morning in the Steel
lamps.text: Heavy blows on seared things burst in holy light 3 m round.

lamps.name: Rooted Stance
lamps.text: After 1 s standing still, heavy blows are 20% wider.

lamps.name: Weight of the Oath
lamps.text: Every blow you strike is heavy and always staggers: Sunder's line comes on every swing. You swing 45% slower, nothing can make you swing faster, and you never strike true.

lamps.name: The Unbroken Line
lamps.text: Sunder's heavy blow no longer splits a line: it breaks the ground all around you, 4 m, at half the blow.

lamps.name: The Long Cut
lamps.text: Learn the Flare The Long Cut.

lamps.name: Second Cut
lamps.text: Another sweep 0.3 s later, inside the 1.2 s.

lamps.name: Line of Morning
lamps.text: The line burns for 4 s.

lamps.name: Through the Wall
lamps.text: The line runs 36 m, and Sundered is 40% weaker armor on bosses.

lamps.name: Dawn in the Steel
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Dawn in the Steel.

lamps.name: High Morning
lamps.text: It holds 8 s.

lamps.name: Crescents Through
lamps.text: Its crescents pierce everything.

lamps.name: Mending Light
lamps.text: A kill by a crescent mends 0.5%.

lamps.name: Shield Arm
lamps.text: Your shield turns one blow in seven. Every blow that reaches you, turned or not, lays a stone; at six, the wall answers with a rebuke of holy light 8 m all around you (a boss takes half).
+5% block while you stand still.
+5% block against champions' and bosses' blows.
+2 Resolve.
Barrier is 15% stronger while you hold three stones or more.
+2 Resolve.
Rebukes and the Watch Bell strike champions 15% harder.
Each block mends 0.5% of health while you're above half.

lamps.name: Shield and Edge
lamps.text: After a block, Oathblade swings at once.

lamps.name: Reaching Oath
lamps.text: Oathblade reaches 1.5 m further.

lamps.name: Morning Edge
lamps.text: Each Oathblade swing throws a crescent of light 6 m.

lamps.name: Readier Wall
lamps.text: The wall answers at five stones.

lamps.name: Rebuke the Strong
lamps.text: Rebuke strikes champions twice as hard.

lamps.name: Answering Light
lamps.text: Each rebuke mends 1% of health.

lamps.name: Loud Bell
lamps.text: The Watch Bell draws from 10 m.

lamps.name: Iron Bell
lamps.text: What the bell draws in is slowed 30%.

lamps.name: Bell and Barrier
lamps.text: Each thing the bell draws gives a barrier of 3% of health.

lamps.name: Mortar
lamps.text: Stones last through a lull, and each block gives a barrier of 1% of health.

lamps.name: Turned Arrows
lamps.text: Blocked missiles fly back at whoever loosed them.

lamps.name: Planted
lamps.text: +15% block while you stand still.

lamps.name: Heavy Shield
lamps.text: Blocking a champion's blow stuns it 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Faith in the Wall
lamps.text: While your barrier is above a fifth of health, holy damage is 20% higher.

lamps.name: The Wall Holds
lamps.text: Block chance is doubled, to 75% at most, but you can't block while moving.

lamps.name: Bearer of Blows
lamps.text: What you block isn't lost: it's stored, and let out as holy damage by your next rebuke. You mend 30% less.

lamps.name: Bell of the Morning
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Bell of the Morning.

lamps.name: Fourth Toll
lamps.text: The bell tolls a fourth time.

lamps.name: Bell for the Dead
lamps.text: Lesser things flee for 3 s after the last toll.

lamps.name: Healing Peal
lamps.text: Each toll mends 8%.

lamps.name: Sixty on the Wall
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Sixty on the Wall.

lamps.name: Shield-Brothers
lamps.text: The wall strikes out once a second.

lamps.name: The Wall Walks
lamps.text: The wall moves with you.

lamps.name: Night Watch
lamps.text: It holds 9 s.
+2 Might.

lamps.name: Shield Swing
lamps.text: Heavy blows lay stones, and each block makes the next heavy blow 30% harder.
Heavy blows and blocks each make the next 10% harder, for 2 s.

lamps.name: Sword-and-Board
lamps.text: You may carry a greatsword and a shield together. The greatsword strikes 15% slower, and the shield blocks half as often.

lamps.name: Oath and Bell
lamps.text: The Watch Bell tolls when you stagger something, at most every 3 s.
+2 Resolve.

lamps.name: The Reaver's Chain
lamps.text: Your dash form is Grapple Chain: every 6 s the next dash throws the hook up to 12 m at the first thing in its aim and hauls you to it. With nothing to bite, it's a plain dash.

lamps.name: Whirling Chain
lamps.text: On landing, the chain whirls, striking everything 3 m round.

lamps.name: Moored
lamps.text: Landing gives a barrier of 12% of health.

lamps.name: Second Hook
lamps.text: A kill within 3 s of the haul brings the wait back.

lamps.name: Reel
lamps.text: Lesser things are dragged to you instead.

lamps.name: War Cry
lamps.text: Ten or more things within 5 m, or a champion strikes you: roar. Lesser things flee 2.5 s, and you strike 25% harder for 6 s. Every 16 s.

lamps.name: Terror
lamps.text: Champions flee the roar too, for a second.

lamps.name: Bloodlust
lamps.text: You run 20% faster while the roar drives you.

lamps.name: Red Tide
lamps.text: Below a third of health: a red roar that mends 10% of health and drives you 30% harder for 4 s. Every 25 s.

lamps.name: Second Tide
lamps.text: Red Tide comes every 18 s.

lamps.name: Blood for the Flare
lamps.text: Kills by a bleed fill the Flare as a champion's kill does, a tenth as much.

lamps.name: Not Done Yet
lamps.text: A Flare cast below a third of health mends half again as much.

lamps.name: Nothing Spared
lamps.text: All mending is 50% stronger. You have no draught.

lamps.name: Banked Flame
lamps.text: Hold two Flares. The second fills half as fast; a Flare fired with both held strikes 75% harder.

lamps.name: Red Hands
lamps.text: Each hit gives +1% attack speed (Frenzy), to 20; it fades when the fight lulls.
Bleeding things take 10% more from melee.
Bleeds last 20% longer while Frenzy is at ten or more.
+2 Might.
Below half health, kills mend 0.5% of health.
+2 Might.
Thrown steel strikes bleeding things 12% harder.
Frenzy fades half as fast.

lamps.name: Four Chops
lamps.text: Carve chops four times.

lamps.name: Deeper Cuts
lamps.text: Carve's bleeds run 30% deeper.

lamps.name: Reaching Chops
lamps.text: Carve reaches 1.5 m further.

lamps.name: Two Cleavers
lamps.text: Two cleavers fly.

lamps.name: Ricochet
lamps.text: The cleaver strikes a second bleeding thing on its way back.

lamps.name: Another Way Back
lamps.text: The cleaver comes back by another path.

lamps.name: Bleeding Gyre
lamps.text: Axe Gyre's axes make what they strike bleed.

lamps.name: Wide Gyre
lamps.text: Axe Gyre whirls 25% wider.

lamps.name: Gyre on a Kill
lamps.text: A kill by the axes brings Axe Gyre's next whirl 30% sooner.

lamps.name: Deep Frenzy
lamps.text: Frenzy builds to 40.

lamps.name: Fights Best Hurt
lamps.text: Below a third of health, blows strike 30% harder and kills mend 1%.

lamps.name: Open Vein
lamps.text: A blow on a thing bleeding for 3 s or more bursts the bleed.

lamps.name: Red Work
lamps.text: Killing a bleeding thing mends 1% of health.

lamps.name: Hamstrung
lamps.text: Bleeding champions are 20% slower.

lamps.name: Always Bleeding
lamps.text: You always count as below a third of health for Fights Best Hurt and Blood Up. You can't be mended above half, and what would mend past it is lost.

lamps.name: The Butcher's Count
lamps.text: Each kill gives +1% damage for 10 s, to 50. You take more by half the Count.

lamps.name: The Butcher's Bill
lamps.text: Learn the Flare The Butcher's Bill.

lamps.name: Running Tab
lamps.text: The leftover chops can go on twice.

lamps.name: Wide Chops
lamps.text: Each chop strikes everything 2 m round.

lamps.name: Feast
lamps.text: Each kill mends 10%.

lamps.name: Butcher's Hour
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Butcher's Hour.

lamps.name: Overtime
lamps.text: A kill adds 0.6 s (up to 12 s more).

lamps.name: Red Mist
lamps.text: Lesser things near you flee.

lamps.name: Not Today
lamps.text: While it holds, you can't fall below 1 health.

lamps.name: Hooked
lamps.text: Chain Lash's hook leaves things Bound for 2 s: tethered where they stand, and taking more from what strikes an area.
Bound things take 10% more from storm.
Area skills strike 8% harder at Bound things.
+2 Might.
Shock lasts 20% longer on Bound things.
+2 Wits.
Each Bound thing within 6 m gives +1 armor, to +10.
Storm skills reach 10% further while three or more things are Bound.

lamps.name: Double Lash
lamps.text: Chain Lash lashes twice.

lamps.name: Barbed Hook
lamps.text: The hooked thing bleeds.

lamps.name: Lash Back
lamps.text: The lash cracks back the way it came.

lamps.name: Two Anchors
lamps.text: Two anchors land.

lamps.name: Heavy Anchor
lamps.text: The anchor's landing stuns 0.5 s.

lamps.name: Live Anchor
lamps.text: The anchor shocks what it binds.

lamps.name: Palm on the Chain
lamps.text: Iron Palms strike Bound things 20% harder.

lamps.name: Ringing Palm
lamps.text: Iron Palms shock what they strike.

lamps.name: Palm Storm
lamps.text: Iron Palms strike 15% more often.

lamps.name: Fast Binding
lamps.text: Bound lasts 4 s, and Anchor binds 7 m round.

lamps.name: Conductor
lamps.text: Shock on a Bound thing leaps to every other Bound thing.

lamps.name: Short Leash
lamps.text: Hooked things are dragged 2 m further.

lamps.name: Knot
lamps.text: Eight Bound things close together are stunned 1 s.

lamps.name: Iron Reach
lamps.text: Iron Palms strike Bound things from 6 m.

lamps.name: The Long Chain
lamps.text: Melee skills reach 3 m further and hook the last thing they hit. They strike 20% weaker.

lamps.name: Lightning Rod
lamps.text: Storm skills strike Bound things first, and 40% harder. You take 15% more from storm and fire.

lamps.name: Drag Them Under
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Drag Them Under.

lamps.name: Deeper
lamps.text: The hooks reach the whole screen.

lamps.name: Grinder
lamps.text: The knot is shredded for a breath before the slam.

lamps.name: Hold Him
lamps.text: A boss is pinned 3 s.

lamps.name: Storm on the Chain
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Storm on the Chain.

lamps.name: Second Length
lamps.text: A second chain; the sweeps alternate.

lamps.name: Earthing
lamps.text: Each sky strike mends 1%.

lamps.name: Wide Lash
lamps.text: The sweeps reach 11 m.
+2 Might.

lamps.name: Red Chain
lamps.text: Bound things bleed; bleeding things stay Bound 1 s longer.
Bleeding things are Bound 1 s on a hook.

lamps.name: Cleaver on a Chain
lamps.text: Hurled Cleaver flies on your chain, hooks what it hits and drags it to you. It no longer returns through the crowd.

lamps.name: Hook and Hatchet
lamps.text: A blow on a Bound thing adds a stack of Frenzy.
+2 Resolve.

lamps.name: The Arcanist's Glass
lamps.text: Your dash form is Mirror Step: every 8 s the next dash leaves two reflections where you stood. They draw what hunts you, and burst when broken.

lamps.name: Hall of Mirrors
lamps.text: Mirror Step leaves three.

lamps.name: Cold Glass
lamps.text: A breaking reflection chills everything it cuts.

lamps.name: Fighting Reflections
lamps.text: Your reflections strike at what comes for them.

lamps.name: Glass Heart
lamps.text: Each reflection that breaks mends 4% of health.

lamps.name: Time Slip
lamps.text: A blow that would take a quarter of your health, or a champion's mark closing on you: 3.5 s at a third of the speed. Every 30 s.

lamps.name: Borrowed Time
lamps.text: Dashes come back three times as fast in the slip.

lamps.name: Deep Slip
lamps.text: In the slip, everything moves at a fifth.

lamps.name: Spellward
lamps.text: Whenever three of your spells land in one second: a barrier of 10% of health. Every 8 s.

lamps.name: Thick Ward
lamps.text: Spellward's barrier is 15% of health.

lamps.name: Kindling
lamps.text: Spells that strike three or more things at once fill the Flare a little.

lamps.name: Glass Clutch
lamps.text: A Flare cast below a third of health leaves two reflections.

lamps.name: Unbound Casting
lamps.text: Spells wait 30% less. You have 20% less health.

lamps.name: Banked Flame
lamps.text: Hold two Flares. The second fills half as fast; a Flare fired with both held strikes 75% harder.

lamps.name: Fire on Ice
lamps.text: Fire striking a frozen thing shatters it, 2 m round, at half its blow.
Burning things take 10% more from frost.
Chill builds 15% faster on things standing in your fire.
+2 Wits.
Zone spells last 15% longer while you stand in one.
+2 Wits.
Shatters strike champions 15% harder.
Frozen things take 10% more from fire.

lamps.name: Two Cinders
lamps.text: Cinderfall drops two.

lamps.name: Wider Fall
lamps.text: Cinderfall lands 25% wider.

lamps.name: Slow Burning
lamps.text: Cinderfall's burn lasts 50% longer.

lamps.name: Cross of Fire
lamps.text: A second line crosses the first.

lamps.name: Hedge of Fire
lamps.text: The line is 12 m long.

lamps.name: Rolling Wall
lamps.text: The line rolls toward the pack.

lamps.name: Quick Frost
lamps.text: Rime Field freezes after 1 s.

lamps.name: Wide Field
lamps.text: Rime Field is 30% wider.

lamps.name: Shatter Field
lamps.text: What thaws in Rime Field shatters.

lamps.name: Thermal Shock
lamps.text: The shatter is 3 m round and strikes as hard as the blow.

lamps.name: Ashen Ground
lamps.text: Your burning ground lasts 50% longer.

lamps.name: Ford-Cold Ground
lamps.text: Rime Field chills before it freezes.

lamps.name: Firebreak Wall
lamps.text: Pyre Line stops missiles.

lamps.name: Stand in Your Fire
lamps.text: In your burning ground: +20% armor, and spells come 10% sooner.

lamps.name: Frostfire
lamps.text: Burn and chill no longer cancel: your fire chills and your frost burns. Each is 30% weaker.

lamps.name: Ash Walker
lamps.text: In your burning or frozen ground you take 40% less. Outside it, your spells are 15% weaker.

lamps.name: Burns Twice
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Burns Twice.

lamps.name: More Embers
lamps.text: Eighteen embers fall.

lamps.name: Black Ice
lamps.text: Frozen things below half health shatter even without an ember.

lamps.name: Called Down
lamps.text: Every ember falls on the toughest frozen thing.

lamps.name: Hard Winter
lamps.text: Learn the Flare Hard Winter.

lamps.name: Deep Winter
lamps.text: It freezes after 1 s.

lamps.name: Thaw-Burst
lamps.text: A shatter shatters the frozen within 3 m.

lamps.name: Winter Keeps
lamps.text: Mend 2% a second while it holds.

lamps.name: Moonmarked
lamps.text: Motes mark what they strike; a marked thing that dies passes its mark to one more.
Marked things take 8% more from projectiles.
Arcane projectiles fly 15% faster.
+2 Wits.
A marked thing's death mends 0.3% of health.
+2 Wits.
Arcane strikes champions 10% harder while they're marked.
Marks last 30% longer.

lamps.name: Split Motes
lamps.text: Seeking Motes split in two on a kill.

lamps.name: Swift Motes
lamps.text: Seeking Motes come 20% sooner.

lamps.name: Heavy Motes
lamps.text: Seeking Motes strike 25% harder and fly slower.

lamps.name: Twin Wells
lamps.text: Three wells may hang at once.

lamps.name: Wide Well
lamps.text: Wells fire at what passes within 9 m.

lamps.name: Deep Well
lamps.text: Wells hold 12 s.

lamps.name: Two Lanterns
lamps.text: Two wisps drift out.

lamps.name: Far-Wandering
lamps.text: The wisp drifts 50% further.

lamps.name: Guttering
lamps.text: The wisp bursts when it goes out.

lamps.name: Silvered
lamps.text: Marks pass to two, and the marked take 10% more.

lamps.name: Many Lights
lamps.text: Spells loose one more projectile.

lamps.name: Moon-Drawn
lamps.text: Motes seek the marked first.

lamps.name: Still Water
lamps.text: Moonwell lasts 50% longer and fires 30% faster.

lamps.name: Moonfire
lamps.text: A mark that passes flares violet: the new bearer takes a tenth of the dead one's health as moonfire.

lamps.name: The Echo
lamps.text: Every spell fires again 0.5 s later at half strength. Spells wait 25% longer.

lamps.name: Crowded Sky
lamps.text: Spells with projectiles loose two more, all seeking, and no two strike the same thing; each is 35% weaker.

lamps.name: The Branding
lamps.text: Learn the Flare The Branding.

lamps.name: Second Brand
lamps.text: It brands again 1 s later.

lamps.name: Branded Deep
lamps.text: The bursts are 50% wider.

lamps.name: The Eye
lamps.text: The boss's brand stays 6 s and bursts again whenever a mark passes to it.

lamps.name: The Drowned Moon
lamps.text: Learn the Flare The Drowned Moon.

lamps.name: Full Moon
lamps.text: Twice the motes.

lamps.name: Moonset
lamps.text: It ends by bursting upward, 8 m round.

lamps.name: Silver Tide
lamps.text: Marks pass to three.
+2 Wits.

lamps.name: Two Schools
lamps.text: Rime Field's frozen ground makes Lantern-Man flare twice as often.
Marked things freeze 20% sooner.

lamps.name: The Ledger
lamps.text: Some of them keep ledgers. Each fire or frost spell makes your next moon or shadow spell 30% harder, and the other way round. A spell of the same side twice running is 15% weaker.

lamps.name: Cold Moon
lamps.text: Motes chill what they strike; a frozen thing's mark passes when it shatters.
+2 Resolve.

lamps.name: The Stalker's Spring
lamps.text: Your dash form is Vault: every 6 s the next dash springs 6 m the way you aim, untouchable in the air, and leaves caltrops where you left.

lamps.name: Parting Volley
lamps.text: In the air, knives are loosed back at where you left.

lamps.name: Caltrops Hold
lamps.text: What steps on the caltrops is stuck 1.5 s.

lamps.name: Light Feet
lamps.text: Landing gives back a dash.

lamps.name: Nimble
lamps.text: Vault's wait is a third shorter.

lamps.name: Mark Prey
lamps.text: Every 9 s the strongest thing in sight becomes your prey: it takes 50% more and dies below 20%.

lamps.name: Two Prey
lamps.text: The two strongest become prey.

lamps.name: Executioner
lamps.text: Prey dies outright below 30%.

lamps.name: Smoke Bomb
lamps.text: A perfect dash throws smoke: 3 s unseen, and your strikes are sure. Every 12 s.

lamps.name: Choking Smoke
lamps.text: The smoke hangs where it fell and poisons what breathes it.

lamps.name: Hunter's Patience
lamps.text: Perfect dashes fill the Flare half again as much.

lamps.name: Into the Smoke
lamps.text: A Flare cast below a third of health leaves you unseen for 2 s after.

lamps.name: Light Step
lamps.text: Three dash charges. Each dash is 30% shorter.

lamps.name: Banked Flame
lamps.text: Hold two Flares. The second fills half as fast; a Flare fired with both held strikes 75% harder.

lamps.name: Opening
lamps.text: For 2 s after a dash, your blows strike true.
Poisoned things take 10% more from steel.
True strikes poison what they strike.
+2 Finesse.
Dashes come back 8% faster while something within 4 m is poisoned.
+2 Finesse.
Thrown steel strikes 12% harder within the Opening.
